title: Taaqeh gufte xongolo
intro: quuka le muuci qadli daffeyna fan xayyoowe, ken xongolo meysi hinnay niya luk diriirigta. taqabi cankah suge, uxih tet fidga waktit qagaaqagitak, xukko cina qaada fidga. iyyak sugteeh ta rooci weeqa kaak cutuukaak darrel yoobbeeh?
clues: Anu qilsi sorkocô baxa luk emeete, yi arraaba axawah tan caagidil qadli gorrisa.
Yi xaaqo dubuk farmoytah masuginna; toh taturteh, tiyay inkih yaabbe.
Yok saduh yaabe qangor dumaahi waktih silsilatih innal suge.
Anu inni massakaxxah ximoo kee maknay luk qadaaqadiseh sabab abe.
maybalaalaqa obteh, dumaahi gititte tibba haanam kee yi biyak oggolak.
oson yoh seecan numuy yi baqla wagittaamal anaakar abe, kee yi migaq sitta ceela mafdaga yoo currik iyya.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: isi baqla wagittaamal qadaaqada barra ( khawla binti tha'laba)
identity.answer: isi baqla wagittaamal qadaaqada barra ( khawla binti tha'laba)

trial.label: gibbatu akkek tekkooka
options: Is malaytu luk sugteeh, alqi maxhaxak sugte
is foocal taqabi le cabtih qaada
is malikak sugte farmoytallih mabbaloowak sugte
Is isi baxa caylale numuk qellisse
trial.answer: is foocal taqabi le cabtih qaada

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Is idaltuh alqi barkat luk sugte
Is qaada baysaanam qibaadah baxxaqsa geyte
is nabiyyi yekkeh yan baxa geyte
outcome.answer: Is qaada baysaanam qibaadah baxxaqsa geyte

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
